newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE traded 12.4 mln contracts in record August.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE traded 12.4 mln contracts in record August.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) said on Tuesday it traded 12.4 million contracts last month, the highest-ever volume for the month of August and up 23 percent from a year ago.
For the year to date, the exchange said 108.5 million futures and options contracts have been traded, up 21 percent on the same period last year.
"It is very encouraging that the exchange has traded record volume for the traditionally quiet month of August," LIFFE's Chairman Jack Wigglesworth said in a statement.

LIFFE said that the three-month euromark interest futures contract set a new daily record on August 22, trading 438,291 contracts and topping the previous record of 427,760 traded on April 18 this year.
A daily record was also set in American style FTSE index options, which traded 57,736 contracts on August 16.
European style FTSE options set a monthly record, trading 348,218 contracts in August compared with a previous record of 244,374 in July, LIFFE said.
